name: conversation-troubleshooter
description: Read-only investigation workflows for authorized logs, tenant-scoped databases, Sentry incidents, dependency code, and validated exports.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate logs, data, Sentry, and code
interface.longDescription: Dynamically discovers authorized log services, tenant-scoped database objects, Sentry projects, and local-to-remote dependency code, then correlates evidence and validates bounded exports.
capabilities: Validated CSV and XLSX export workflows
defaultPrompt: Trace this conversation end to end and identify the earliest verified break point.
Find matching logs, data, Sentry evidence, and dependency code within the authorized scope.
Export the bounded matching data and report validation counts and completeness.
